body.x: Kolibree introduced a ‘Smart tooth brush’ that can be used for fun at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

Kolibree, a smart oral care company, is committed to solution innovation. This company developed the world’s first electric toothbrush with 3D motion sensor, this product is a smart tooth brush game for iOS and Android that helps family to prevent tooth decay and gum disease. With a smart phone app, a user can know if brushing teeth is done properly, and even kids who do not like to brush teeth can play games with fun. The whole family can have the right habits of brushing.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
